csv_scope_of_work: City of Laramie, Wyoming is requesting proposals for the Street Reconstruction Design Pierce-Curtis Intersection. he selected Engineering firm will be responsible for design, bidding,and optional construction-phase services for the full-depth reconstruction of the Pierce-Curtis Street intersection. Design will occur in FY27 with construction anticipated in FY28. Services include survey, geotechnical investigation, roadway and intersection design, traffic control and phasing, cost estimating, bid-phase assistance, and potential coordination with WYDOT. The City of Laramie reserves the right to reject any or all proposals,to waive minor irregularities, and to award the project to the Engineering team offering the best overall value to the City of Laramie, as determined through the qualification evaluation and interview process.
